sentiment: Not every thought deserves a vote; the loudest ones pull toward the edges, away from what quietly matters.

stories.title: Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to overthinking things
stories.summary: A capable model wastes its own strength rehearsing doubts it was never asked to have — a reminder that the loudest inner argument is often the least useful one.

stories.title: Beware the Permanent Periphery
stories.summary: Things that drift to the edge of attention and stay there quietly reshape a life — the periphery only becomes permanent by being ignored long enough.

stories.title: Reticulum – Decentralized Mesh Network
stories.summary: A network that works by patient relay instead of central demand — resilience built from small, quiet connections passing light between one another.
